motionReviewMethod: Actual source movie frames 20, 60 and 118 inspected for every level in twenty contact sheets; placement progression, normal gameplay UI, weather and completed state are visible. This is temporal sampling, not continuous human playback.
rejection: Many source MP4s have an AAC stream but zero audio packets. Montage rejected before delivery. Repeat recordings require decoded nonsilent audio per source.

rejectedInitialVisualReview.rejection: Many source MP4s have an AAC stream but zero audio packets. Montage rejected before delivery. Repeat recordings require decoded nonsilent audio per source.

rejectedReplay.reason: First guest placement did not reach witness; recording rejected before delivery; prior successful captures retained.

finalReviewMethod: All 99 crossfade midpoints inspected from the final MP4; eight full-resolution encoded gameplay frames inspected for compression, UI, placement grid, aircraft, dense foliage, snowfall and fog. Source temporal frames reviewed for every level. Full movie/audio decoding and per-level audio checks are separate machine validations; this is not a claim of continuous human playback/listening.
qualityNotes: Final compression softens fine vegetation while keeping gameplay UI and tent silhouettes readable.
The native thin placement grid has lower contrast on bright snow (notably level 81); the capture preserves the actual player view. Full-size stills are also provided.
